charts.title: WASP-4 b: orbits around WASP-4
charts.description: The orbits of WASP-4's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-4 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Sodickson & Grunblatt 2025 (2025ApJ...993...78S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname SODICKSON__AMP__GRUNBLATT_2025): P 1.33823136361 d

charts.title: WASP-4 b: its transit
charts.description: WASP-4 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (103, 105, 106) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 402026209, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 9-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
